// diagnostic

E0919

`#Inline(Always) fn` body exceeds the checked promise's statement ceiling (D-METHODMACRO1)

What

`#Inline(Always) fn` body exceeds the checked promise's statement ceiling (D-METHODMACRO1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0919

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0919: tests/ui/inline_always_too_large.stderr.

Error [E0919]: `big` is too large for `#Inline(Always)`
  --> tests/ui/inline_always_too_large.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | #Inline(Always) fn big() Int -> {
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: its body has 44 statements — over the 40-statement ceiling `#Inline(Always)` enforces so a promised inline doesn't quietly bloat every call site.
 Fix: drop `#Inline(Always)` (use `#Inline` as a hint the compiler is free to ignore), or split the function so the hot part is small enough to inline.
